def equation(gate_voltage_abs: np.ndarray, drain_voltage_abs: np.ndarray, parameters: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Modelo empírico bivariado para log10(|ID|/A)."""
    """Improved version of `equation_v0` with interactions between VGS and VDS."""
    
    # Isolate the linear terms and quadratic terms
    a1 = parameters[0]
    a2 = parameters[1]
    a3 = parameters[2]
    a4 = parameters[3]
    a5 = parameters[4]
    a6 = parameters[5]
    b1 = parameters[6]
    b2 = parameters[7]
    b3 = parameters[8]
    b4 = parameters[9]
    b5 = parameters[10]
    b6 = parameters[11]
    
    # Calculate the components of the linear terms and quadratic terms
    linear = a1 * gate_voltage_abs + a2 * drain_voltage_abs + (a3 * gate_voltage_abs) * (drain_voltage_abs)
    quadratic = a4 * (gate_voltage_abs * gate_voltage_abs) + a5 * (drain_voltage_abs * drain_voltage_abs) + (
            a6 * gate_voltage_abs * drain_voltage_abs)
